newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Oct 23.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Oct 23.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker levels on Wednesday finished lower, dragged down by weaker cargo prices, traders said. A trader at a major oil company said he sold a 2,000 tonne 180-cst cargo to a Japanese shipowner at $125.50 per tonne. He said high inventories have forced sellers who were anticipating prices to ease lower, to sell off their surplus stocks.
